## `General Corporate Entity` 💣

**F1:** 0.002 | **Precision:** 0.022 | **Recall:** 0.001  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `79b20388`  
**Description:**
Matches corporate entities ending in GmbH, AG, or GmbH & Co KG. Strictly requires the name to start with a capital letter or specific prefix, excluding preceding context like 'der', 'die', 'bei', 'von', 'Entscheidungsrelevanter', and ensuring 'AG' is not part of a larger word like 'AG3'.

**Content:**
```
(?<![a-zA-Z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df\d])(?:(?:Fa\.|Dr\.?|Univ\.-Prof\.?|Prof\.?|Ing\.?|Dipl\.?|B\.?|M\.?|LL\.?B\.?|LL\.?M\.?|X\.)\s+)?(?<![\s\w])([A-Z][a-zA-Z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df\s&+\-0-9]*(?:\s+(?:Mag\.?|Dr\.?|Univ\.-Prof\.?|Prof\.?|Ing\.?|Dipl\.?|B\.?|M\.?|LL\.?B\.?|LL\.?M\.?)+)?[A-Z][a-zA-Z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df\s&+\-0-9]*(?:GmbH|AG|GmbH\s+&\s+Co\s+KG))(?![a-zA-Z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df])(?!\s+als\s+Gruppenmitglied)
```
